handoffs.note: Contained the only real prepared CP-Math backend without revising frozen generic interfaces. CusparseBellBackend now rejects any padded row or feature domain before context initialization or descriptor creation because v1 dense bindings expose no allocation capacities; prepared BELL state snapshots operation metadata and bindings and rejects stale structure, execution order, pointer/identity bindings, or physical geometry/materialization before vendor launch. CP-Math BELL source is explicitly experimental and DeviceMathContext is not presented as an external/Baseplane ABI. Tests cover 9x13 BELL8, 17x31 BELL16, and 33x65 BELL32 padded cases, device guard regions, stale structure/order/binding/geometry, and unsupported numeric combinations. Evidence: host operation contract passed; direct CUDA 12.9 nvcc sm_70 builds passed; cpMathRuntimeTest passed; cpMathCusparseBellTest passed repeatedly on leased V100 gpu:0; CUDA 12.9 compute-sanitizer memcheck of --padded-rejection-only exited 0 with ERROR SUMMARY: 0 errors. Full aligned BELL under sanitizer separately exposed an existing BELL8 column-major numerical mismatch while reporting zero memory errors; ordinary runs pass, no BELL repair was attempted, and the path remains quarantined experimental evidence. No CMake, Baseplane, CellShard, benchmark, or public frozen interface file changed.

The image is fixed-width little-endian, 64-byte-aligned, sectioned and pointer-free; mandatory work/layout/cover sections plus opaque optional extensions are independently checksummed. Whole-image checksum and a two-word derived geometry identity cover serialized semantics. Validation proves directory bounds/alignment/uniqueness, checksums, exact permutations and exact logical-edge ownership using caller workspace. Earlier wrapper receipt3461419e is explicitly non-acceptance: absent13.1 executable/no test execution despite outer exit0. No machinery edits. Scoped ctxpp lint clear. handoffs.note: Implemented CE-PTR-13 at actual lane commit 08ae74f9ff5201cc8139cc7053bf82245f42f33f. CE-PTR-06 proposal/refinement/rollback scratch no longer owns ten std::vectors: one exact 64-byte-aligned prepared host slab is sliced into bounded non-owning typed relation views, with preflight overflow/capacity checks and no mutation-time growth/reallocation. The permanent non-strict source gate passes without changing ceilings. Wired device_descriptor and all CE-PTR memory implementation files into Cellerator::runtime; added normal CMake targets for host/session memory contracts, executable/training programs, graph-capture concurrency, and persisted replay. Removed the stale CellShard::runtime link from forward_neighbors and documented its caller-owned prepared-view/downstream-construction boundary. Preserved host_buffer, shared-owned device_buffer, and growable scratch compatibility helpers because reinventory found live production/example/adapter consumers; deletion would violate the no-deletion-with-live-consumers contract, so CE-PTR-15 must retain their documented transitional disposition rather than claim retirement. Validation: Release configure on CUDA 12.9.86, Tesla V100 sm_70; full cmake --build build-ce-ptr-integration -j "$(nproc)" PASS. PASS: cellPackOptimizerTest; celleratorMemoryContractTest; celleratorSessionMemoryTest; celleratorExecutionSessionTest (64 persistent slots, transient 6144 bytes, 2 launch binds); celleratorValueReadinessTest; celleratorExecutableProgramTest; celleratorTrainingProgramTest; celleratorCeLiveConcurrencyTest (sealed allocation/sync invariants and CUDA Graph capture/replay); celleratorCeLiveProgramReplayTest (CPE2/CPEXEC01 typed activation/planner/quantitative CUDA); forward-neighbor target rebuild without CellShard runtime. Permanent source gate: python3 scripts/check_no_inappropriate_core_stl.py PASS. Mutex-protected cellPackOptimizerBench PASS: 5000 features, 4096 sampled rows, 320000 evaluator nnz, objective 320000 to 301340, 38 oracle evaluations, total 1434.04 ms, peak additional optimizer bytes 8925258. Compute Sanitizer could not run because libsanitizer-collection.so is unavailable; no sanitizer result is claimed. git diff --check PASS and worktree clean.

invariants.rule: Custom CUDA promotion requires reference correctness, relevant Compute Sanitizer tools, robust median/spread timing, profiler evidence, and a repeatable caller-visible win; evaluated_not_promoted is success when the experiment is sound.
CellShard remains an opaque storage, transport, placement, and residency layer and does not interpret Cellerator execution-image tile grammar.

CE-ARCH-70 hardens existing execution foundations only: no new kernel family, projection family, distributed subsystem, generic graph or tensor framework, training path, Tensor Core path, or CellShard placement implementation.
Preserve unrelated dirty work, especially the local Baseplane predicate-plan implementation; do not reset, clean, stash, overwrite, or attribute it without an ownership audit.

Reuse existing warp tiles and compact values. Native SpMM metadata is a sidecar; do not create a second native packed matrix, row permutation, or duplicate values without measured schema-revision evidence.
After an execution failure that may have partially written output, do not silently retry another backend.

PackingPlan contains durable data-derived structure only; PhysicalExecutionViews are derived; MathRequest has mathematics but no backend; ExecutionPlan is immutable pointer-free metadata; PreparedExecution owns live CUDA state.
Repeated PreparedExecution run calls perform no search, tuning, lowering, descriptor creation, general allocation/free, or reusable dense-RHS repacking.
No custom SpMM production promotion or final performance claim is legal without an accessible real biological CP-BP corpus and recorded representation/runtime distributions.
Canonical Cellerator source, focused tests, Git state, and live SQLite coordination state are authoritative; Markdown and .ctxpp views are projections or read-only retrieval artifacts.
Volta sm_70 on CUDA 12.x is a product target. Do not require a toolchain migration that drops SM70 without user approval.

Use cuSPARSE for conventional CSR/BELL, cuBLASLt for ordinary dense work, CUB for data movement primitives, and custom CUDA only for CellPack structure vendor APIs cannot express.
Moonshot amendment (2026-10-02): For the explicitly authorized CE-MOON research outcomes, isolated experiments/baseplane_moonshot kernels may implement alternative numerical and learned mechanisms from inception; use meaningful vendor comparators where applicable. This exception grants no production promotion, frozen-contract change, new general runtime, or activation of unrelated epics; existing BENCH-EVIDENCE, FAIR-NUMERICS and REAL-DATA-PROMOTION requirements remain.

FORENSIC STATE. Root v2 project 1f07f97e was revision 441; Baseplane project 1a7de0f4 was revision 16. All repositories were on main/origin-main with one worktree and initially clean. No active claims, locks, GPU, benchmark, profiler, sanitizer, or dataset leases existed. Root audit already had stale historical CP-Math gate hashes; Baseplane audit already had stale STACK-BITOP-01 gate hashes. CellShard was read-only.
BUILD AND ABI. Root CMake wires only cpMathPackedDenseOperandBench from bench/math/packed_dense_operand_bench.cu plus packed_dense_operand.cu. No reusable CP-Math library and no math_* test target exists. CP-Math operation_kind is SpMM-only. PreparedExecution owns a DeviceMathContext and copied math_request launch bindings; DeviceMathContext wraps existing Cellerator::runtime stream, handle caches, and one mutable scratch allocation. Planner sorting is structural heuristic, not measured total runtime. physical_bell_view has logical and padded dimensions while dense bindings expose no padded capacities; math_cusparse_bell_test uses aligned 64x64 only; BELL8 chunks padded rows into 16-row descriptors and preparation creates descriptors, normalizes/copies values, and allocates workspace. include/Cellerator/abi.h is a sparse-layout public C ABI, not automatically the common biological ABI. pointer_migration_plan.md referenced by AGENTS.md is absent. CP-Math arrived in ten commits on 2026-08-18/19, from 11a6b6c through 72f3012, without a durable integrated-core ledger.
CP-MATH CLASSIFICATION. Preserve/adapt: referee.hh/referee.cc and math_referee_foundation_test.cc; operation request validation and math_operation_contract_test.cc; physical view validation patterns in physical_csr.cc, physical_bell.cc, physical_bell_from_cpk1.cc and their tests; backend capability rejection in backend_registry.cc and backends/cusparse_bell.*; packed_dense_operand.* and its benchmark; native_tile_view.* and math_native_tile_adapter_test.cc; deterministic signature ideas in operation_signature.cc. Experimental/quarantined pending owners: operation.hh/cc -> CE-ARCH-10/11/22; runtime.hh, runtime/device_context.cu, runtime/workspace_pool.cu and math_runtime/device_runtime tests -> CE-ARCH-02/12; backend.hh, execution_plan.hh, backend_registry.cc, epilogue.cu and execution tests -> CE-ARCH-22; planner.hh/cc and math_planner_test.cc -> CE-ARCH-31; physical_bell.* and cusparse BELL -> CE-ARCH-02 then CE-ARCH-22/31; physical_csr.* -> CE-ARCH-22; native tile adapter -> CE-ARCH-20/22. Replace substantially: DeviceMathContext integration ABI, prepared-owned stream/bindings, single workspace concurrency, SpMM centrality, hot virtual discovery, heuristic objective, mixed cache identity, and unsafe padded BELL advertisement. No current source was deleted.
CP-BP CLASSIFICATION. CP-BP-00..13 remain completed v1 evidence: support extraction/bitsets/candidates/exact merge/rollback oracle/frozen plan/full apply/local order/records/tiles/direct consumer/referees/statistics/hardware model/CPK1 and direct CellShard staging retain their accepted results. Current row_active_block_references, 32-row/feature assumptions, row-major values, N=1 reduction, canonical output, CPK1 universality, one geometry/format, cost model, and CellPack/core split are supersedable assumptions. The direct tile benchmark wins high/medium sharing (0.017/0.041 ms versus CSR 0.075/0.079) and loses low sharing (0.117 versus 0.095), on controlled synthetic fixtures.
